text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's not it. I made the most of the experience. I think I've grown emotionally too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I'll be able to show off the new and improved version of myself in future races. It's just…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: When I think of having to say goodbye to the fresh seafood they have here, I feel a slight hint of sadness… down in my belly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I should probably buy some food for Oguri Cap to take home with her. I keep that in mind as summer camp wraps up.
